fact: Law n°22-011/AU of 23 June 2022 (Article 70) institutes the online tender management system 'COMORES MARCHES PUBLICS' for public procurement, run by ANADEN, with electronic bid submission, timestamping and e-signature (Articles 69-71 ter).
title: Code des marchés publics 2022 (Loi n°22-011/AU du 23 juin 2022)
